recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for core reconciliation. No core follow-up is needed unless extension ownership changes; any future wording work for codesystem-usage should be made in HL7/fhir-extensions.
issue_request: FHIR-40740 was an Applied/Persuasive Vocabulary change request for http://hl7.org/fhir/StructureDefinition/codesystem-usage. It asked that the extension stop referring to a value set, describe code-system consumers and uses instead, and state that using the extension does not restrict use of the code system.
initial_application: No FHIR core commit or active source/fhir.ini entry was found for FHIR-40740. The Jira comment points to HL7/fhir-extensions PR #120, and extension-pack commit 2d8d6741385fe7229cd5fbeb5ee276ec0abe31a5 changed input/definitions/CodeSystem/StructureDefinition-codesystem-usage.xml to the requested code-system wording.
additional_context: The 2024-03-25 Vocabulary minutes discuss FHIR-40740 against the FHIR Extension Pack pages and explicitly state that the group reviewed valueset-usage and decided not to enter a similar ticket for that extension. Core only has historical release copies and OID registrations for these URLs, while the maintained definitions are in the Extension Pack.
reconciliation: Published an empty external-repo audit commit on the combined core branch. No core source was changed because the authoritative current source is outside this checkout and already contains the requested correction.
